left.raw_text: Patient has not been treated with any of the following medications for at least 2 weeks prior to study start:
- Aspirin or other antiplatelet agents (except low-dose aspirin for cardiovascular prevention)
- Warfarin or other vitamin K antagonists (except for therapeutic use of low-dose warfarin)
- Clopidogrel or other P2Y12 inhibitors (except for therapeutic use of clopidogrel)
